verses.en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.sm: Isaraelu ia Tavita i Heperona, ona latou fai mai lea, ua faapea, Faauta, o i matou o ou ivi ma cu aano i matou nei;

verses.en: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
verses.sm: 0 anamua foi, ina O fai Saulo ma tupu ia te i matou, o Oe lava sa E feta'ita'ina'i ia Isaraelu; na fetalai foi le ALII ia te oe, E te leoleo i loʻu nuu o Isaraelu, e fai foi oe ma ta°ita‘i ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.sm: Ona o mai lea o toeaina uma o Isaraelu i le tupu i Heperona; ua 051 le feagaiga a i latou ma le tupu o Tavita i Heperona iluma o le ALII, ma latou faauu ia Tavita e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.sm: Sa tolu sefulu o tausaga o Tavita ina ua fai o ia ma tupu; e fa sefulu o tausaga sa fai ai O ia ma tupu.

verses.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.sm: Sa fai o ia ma tupu i Heperona ia Iuta i tausaga e fitu ma masina e ono; a ua fai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema ia Isaraelu uma atoa ma Iuta, i tausaga e tolu sefulu ma le tolu.

verses.en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o le tupu ma ona tagata i Ierusalema i sa Iepusé o e sa nonofo i le nuu. A ua latou fai mai ia Tavita, ua faapea mai, E te le sao mai iinei, seia mual ave ese i e tauaso ma e pipili; ua faapea i latou, E le masao mai Tavita iinei.

verses.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
verses.sm: A ua aea e Tavita le olo o Siona, o le aai a Tavita lea.

verses.en: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o Tavita i lea aso, O sé fasi i sa Iepusé, ma oo atu i le alavai, ma fasi i e pipili ma e tauaso ua inosia lava e Tavita, e fai o ia ma alii sili. O le mea lea ua latou fai ane ai, O e tauaso ma E pipili latou te le o mai i le fale.

verses.en: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.sm: Ona nofo ai lea o Tavita i le ‘olo, ua ia faaigoa ai, O le aai a Tavita. Ua ati faataamilo e Tavita, e afua mai i Milo a e 00 i totonu.

verses.en: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
verses.sm: Ua tupu pea lava le mamalu o Tavita, sa ia te ia foi le ALII le Atua o ‘au.

verses.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
verses.sm: Ua auina mai e Hiramo le tupu o Turo le savali ia Tavita, ma na avatu ai laau O arasi, ma tufuga, ma tufuga ati fale; ua latou faia le fale mo Tavita.

verses.en: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
verses.sm: Ona iloa ai lea e Tavita ua faatumauina o ia e le ALII e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu, ma ua faamaualugaina lona malo ona o lona nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.sm: Ua toe fai e Tavita o palake ma ava i Ierusalema, ina ua alu atu nai Heperona; ua toe fanau foi atalii ma afafine o Tavita.

verses.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.sm: O igoa nei o e na fanaua e ia i Ierusalema; o Samua, ma Sopapa, ma Natano, ma Solomona,

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.sm: ma Ivara, ma Elisua, ma Nefeku, ma Iafia,

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.sm: ma Elisama, ma Eliata, ma Elifaleta.

verses.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Filisitia ua faauuina Tavita e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu, ona o ae lea o Filisitia uma e saili ia Tavita; ua logona e Tavita, ona alu ifo lea o 1a i le ‘olo.

verses.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.sm: Ua o atu Filisitia, ma salalau i latou i le vanu o sa Rafa.

verses.en: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.sm: Ona fesili atu lea o Tavita i le ALII, ua faapea atu, Ou te alu ae ea ia Filisitia? E te tuuina mai ea i latou i loʻu lima? Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII ia Tavita, Alu ae ia, aua ou te tuuina atu lava o Filisitia i lou lima.

verses.en: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu Tavita i Paalafaresa, ona fasia lea o i latou e Tavita i lea mea; ona fai ane lea o ia, Ua osofia oʻu fili e le ALII i oʻu luma, pei o le oso mai o le vai, o le mea lea na ia faaigoa ai lea mea o 1Paala-faresa.

verses.en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuulafoai ai o a latou tupua, ona ave ese ai lea e Tavita ma ona tagata.

verses.en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.sm: Ua toe o ae Filisitia, ma salalau i latou i le vanu o sa Rafa.

verses.en: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.sm: Ona fesili atu lea o Tavita 11e ALII; ona fetalai mai lea o ia, Aua e te alu ae, a ia e faataamilo i o latou tua, ma ia alu atu ia te i latou i tala ane O laau o peka.

verses.en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.sm: A E faalogo i le páúú o le savali mai i tumutumu o laau o peka, ona e faataalise ai lea, aua ua alu atu ai le ALII i ou luma e fasi i le itu taua a Filisitia.

verses.en: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
